entries.sense_en: felt but not clearly seen or touched; hard to describe

synonyms.nuance: Not clear or exact; about ideas and feelings more than atmosphere.
Formal; cannot be felt by touch, or is very hard to grasp mentally.
Simply cannot be seen; says nothing about being felt.

entries.sense_en: a heavy cover of gloom or darkness over a place
entries.sense_ko: 온 세상을 뒤덮은 어두운 장막, 음울한 기운

synonyms.nuance: Something that wraps and hides, like mist or secrecy; also a burial cloth.

Neutral cover spread evenly over a large area.

entries.sense_en: a round object; here, a poetic word for the sun
entries.sense_ko: 구체(球體); 여기서는 태양을 뜻하는 시적 표현

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, scientific word for a perfectly round solid shape.
A round body, often the Earth or a map of it.
Everyday word, usually a toy or plain round object; never poetic.

entries.sense_en: a smooth, wave-like rise and fall of a surface

synonyms.nuance: Common word; can be water or motion, and is usually more sudden.
Small, quick waves, like on a pond.
A long, rounded rise, especially of the sea or land.

entries.sense_en: except for; apart from

synonyms.nuance: Ordinary, neutral choice in speech and writing.
Common and friendly; can also mean 'in addition to'.
synonyms.example: apart from the noise, it was fine

synonyms.nuance: Means 'if it were not for'; a different logic from save for.
synonyms.example: but for the rain, we would go

entries.sense_en: a newcomer to the Yukon who has not yet survived a winter

synonyms.nuance: Neutral word for anyone new to a place.
Informal and teasing; someone inexperienced and easily fooled.
Old-fashioned; a beginner not yet used to rough outdoor life.

entries.tip_ko: 치차코 정도로 발음하며, 반대말은 sourdough(유콘의 베테랑)입니다.

entries.sense_en: based on guesses, not on known facts

synonyms.nuance: Similar, but often about risky bets or theories with no proof.
Imagined as a case for the sake of argument.

entries.sense_en: the state of being weak and easily harmed

synonyms.nuance: General word; can also mean a particular flaw or fondness.
Easily broken, said of objects as well as people.

entries.sense_en: be travelling toward a place

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and common; also used for trouble (headed for disaster).
Plain and neutral; describes the journey itself.
Stresses direction, not necessarily a fixed destination.

entries.sense_en: sticking out from a surface

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrase for the same idea.

synonyms.nuance: Swelling outward because something is full or pushed from inside.
Sharp and strong; a hard shape sticking far out.

entries.sense_en: soaked in liquid

synonyms.nuance: General word for leaving something in liquid until it is wet through.
Put in briefly and take out; less thorough than sop.
Wet completely, often by rain or a spill.

entries.sense_en: not usual; not what one normally does

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; the usual choice today.

Casual phrase; slightly more striking.

entries.tip_ko: wanted(원하는)가 아니라 '익숙한'을 뜻하는 wont에서 나온 말입니다.

entries.sense_en: move quietly and low, as if afraid or guilty

synonyms.nuance: Slow and quiet, but not necessarily out of fear.

Hide and move about with bad intentions.

entries.sense_en: dig a hole to hide or stay warm in

synonyms.nuance: Plain, general word; makes a hole for any purpose.

synonyms.nuance: Make a long passage through earth or under something.
Settle snugly into a soft place; comfort more than digging.

entries.sense_en: the lower cheek and jaw of an animal

synonyms.nuance: The bone structure itself; more common than jowl.
The soft side of the face below the eye.
Informal; the jaws and mouth area, often of dogs.

entries.sense_en: something attached to and hanging from a larger thing

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; anything joined on, often on purpose.
An arm, leg or wing; a real body part.
Informal; an extra part added later.

entries.sense_en: a short period of suddenly very cold weather

synonyms.nuance: A period of cold weather that may last longer; less stress on suddenness.

synonyms.example: a cold wave hit the north

synonyms.nuance: Temperature below 0°C, especially harming plants.

entries.sense_en: keep going in the same direction

synonyms.nuance: Plain, common phrase for continuing.
synonyms.example: keep going until the end of the road

synonyms.nuance: Continue with effort despite difficulty.
synonyms.example: we pressed on through the storm

synonyms.nuance: Continue as before; often about routine.

entries.sense_en: came into his mind again and again

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; say or do again.
Say again in different words, to be clearer.
Happen again over time; the thing returns by itself.

entries.sense_en: jumped suddenly sideways in fear

synonyms.nuance: A small quick movement of pain or fear, often in place.
Draw back strongly, often from disgust or shock.
Stop and refuse to go on, like a horse.

entries.tip_ko: '수줍은'이라는 형용사 shy와 같은 단어지만, 동사로는 (특히 말이) 놀라 옆으로 홱 피한다는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: very carefully, afraid of falling or causing harm

synonyms.nuance: General; attention to avoid mistakes, without fear.
Aware of danger and ready to stop.
Suspicious as well as careful.

entries.sense_en: went around the edge of a place instead of across it

synonyms.nuance: Go around entirely, often to save time.
Move in a ring around something.
Keep away from; says nothing about the route.

entries.sense_en: struggled clumsily to move through snow or water

synonyms.nuance: General word for hard effort.
Wild, violent movement of arms and legs.
Trip and nearly fall; not sustained.

entries.sense_en: struck suddenly and hard

synonyms.nuance: Common word for a hard blow.
Plainest word; says nothing about force or drama.
Cause lasting suffering, such as a disease.

entries.sense_en: burned slightly on the surface

synonyms.nuance: Burn the surface enough to leave a brown mark.

synonyms.nuance: Burn until black, more severe.
General word; any level of damage by fire.

entries.sense_en: absolutely necessary; must be done at once

synonyms.nuance: Very important for something to work or succeed.
Needs quick action because time is short.
Necessary for life or success; strong feeling.

entries.sense_en: whether he wanted to or not

synonyms.nuance: Without caring what the circumstances are.
By itself, without conscious thought.
Another common meaning of willy-nilly: in a careless, random way.

entries.sense_en: pulled back suddenly, as if from a blow

synonyms.nuance: Small quick movement, often in one place.
Move back on purpose, often from danger.
Pull away slowly, often from fear or disgust.

entries.sense_en: flowed back and slowly grew less

synonyms.nuance: Lose strength or colour slowly.
Move back, often to a distance.
Get smaller in number or size over time.

entries.sense_en: stay calm and think clearly in a crisis

synonyms.nuance: Plain, general expression.
Informal; also means not to show anger.
Stay brave and steady when frightened.
synonyms.example: kept his nerve at the edge

entries.sense_en: a very large, destructive fire

synonyms.nuance: Common; a strong fire, not always destructive.
Fire that is terrifyingly intense, like hell.
Fire that spreads through forest or grass.

entries.sense_en: turned over and dropped its load

synonyms.nuance: General word for turning upside down.
Casual; something falls on its side.
Fall because top-heavy or unbalanced.

entries.tip_ko: 원래 배가 뒤집힌다는 뜻이며, 여기서는 나뭇가지에 쓰인 비유적 용법입니다.

entries.sense_en: loaded heavily

synonyms.nuance: Literary; heavily loaded, often with 'with'.
Everyday word; carrying something.
Emphasizes the weight that is hard to bear.

entries.sense_en: seeming safe but actually dangerous
entries.sense_ko: 믿을 수 없는, 안전해 보이나 위험한

synonyms.nuance: General; may be obvious danger.
Looks different from reality, not necessarily harmful.
Cannot be trusted to work well.

entries.sense_en: a quiet, sad longing for something out of reach
entries.sense_ko: 닿을 수 없는 것을 향한 애틋한 갈망

synonyms.nuance: Strong, open desire for something.
Sentimental longing for the past.
Deep, restless desire; stronger than wistfulness.

entries.sense_en: searched clumsily with the hands

synonyms.nuance: Feel around, often in the dark.
Search by moving things about.
Plain, casual expression for searching by touch.

entries.sense_en: extremely painful

synonyms.nuance: Causing deep suffering, of body or mind.
Too much to endure; not only pain.
Serious and strong, milder in tone.

entries.sense_en: welcomed gladly

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for gladly receiving.
Say hello or react; not always glad.
Publicly praise something.

entries.sense_en: sulphur, the yellow substance on the match heads

synonyms.nuance: Modern, scientific name of the same element.
American spelling of sulphur.
Fire of hell; brimstone is often paired with it in Bible language.

entries.sense_en: in sudden, uncontrolled jerks

synonyms.nuance: Violent shaking of the whole body.
Short, sharp movements; often of machines.
Starting and stopping, in short bursts.

entries.sense_en: in an awkward way, without skill or control

synonyms.nuance: Uncomfortable or badly arranged movement.
Heavy, noisy and unrefined; more informal.
Lacking skill; formal.

entries.sense_en: without interest or feeling, having given up

synonyms.nuance: Not caring either way.
With no energy or spirit.
As if unable to feel at all, often from shock.

entries.sense_en: moved sideways, warily and quietly

synonyms.nuance: Move slowly and carefully in a direction.
Move low and quietly.
Drag the feet slowly.

entries.sense_en: in a commanding way that expects obedience

synonyms.nuance: Quick and stern in tone.
Like a ruler; proud and bossy.
Strong but not necessarily harsh.

entries.sense_en: choke by squeezing the throat

synonyms.nuance: Kill by squeezing the throat; the usual word.
Stop breath; can be accidental or on food.
Die from lack of air by any cause.

entries.sense_en: sharp and painful to feel

synonyms.nuance: Stirs emotion, often gently; the usual modern sense, not the one here.
Warm, sympathetic emotion.
Sharp and cutting, like a sound or pain.

entries.sense_en: walked unsteadily, about to fall

synonyms.nuance: Heavy, uneven steps from weakness or drink.
Shake side to side; also for objects.
Catch the foot and nearly fall.

entries.sense_en: in a way meant to calm the man's anger

synonyms.nuance: Gentle, comforting.
Aimed at stopping someone's anger.
Giving in, like a lower-ranked person.

entries.sense_en: behave in a silly, embarrassing way

synonyms.nuance: Feel or cause shame; not always silly.

synonyms.nuance: Only about appearance, not action.
Act silly on purpose.

entries.tip_ko: make a fool of somebody는 '~를 놀림감으로 만들다'입니다.

entries.sense_en: scolded gently

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; angry words at someone.
Formal and sharp; serious disapproval.
Official criticism by a boss.
